name: Atlas Legend
description:
## What it does

Adds a small reminder at the bottom of the game's atlas: Configured zones, not live.

## How to use

1. Install and enable Atlas Legend in Studio.
2. Launch your normal game client and enter a character.
3. Press M with chat closed, or click the atlas button on the minimap.
4. Look at the bottom of the atlas for the legend. It appears automatically while the atlas is open.

## Shortcuts

- M: opens or closes the atlas using the supported client's existing game binding.
- Atlas Legend adds no separate keyboard shortcut or standalone window.

## Settings

There are no extra settings for this add-on. Enable, disable or remove it through Studio > Installed add-ons. Close the client before applying a change, then launch it again.

## Good to know

This add-on displays a label; it does not add boss markers or track live spawns. It can run on its own or alongside Boss Atlas. Studio can be closed while you play.
